items.q: What should you remember about **Minimum effective dose**?
items.a: **45 min × 2/week enough for** average 40–60 yr old if intensity + diet are right; time excuse "not relevant.".

items.q: What should you remember about **More volume failed experiment**?
items.a: **Adding 4th day / extra** sets stalled progress 3–4 weeks; cut back → growth resumed (documented logs).

items.q: What should you remember about **One set to failure era**?
items.a: **~1991–92 Mentzer advice added** another growth level; hybrid between pure HIT and conventional BB.

items.q: What should you remember about **Steroid recovery gap**?
items.a: **Champions recover faster; natural** trainees need less total stimulus and more rest between sessions.

items.q: What should you remember about **Diabetes reversal case**?
items.a: **Client**: 3×/week 45 min + low-carb month → out of diabetic/pre-diabetic range, fatty liver enzymes normalized.

items.q: What should you remember about **TRT at 45**?
items.a: **Huberman and Yates both** ~125 mg/week; get as far naturally first.

items.q: What should you remember about **Top-five gate**?
items.a: **1990 Night of Champions**: top 5 or quit competing and steroids.

items.q: What should you remember about **Flexibility over rigidity**?
items.a: **Mentzer too extreme (train every** 10–12 days, cigarettes); Yates kept training for love of movement post-career.

items.q: What should you remember about **Anger as fuel**?
items.a: **Father died 13; channeled** hardship; thick skin from punk/Oi background but quiet demeanor.

items.q: What should you remember about **Women & muscle**?
items.a: **~1%/yr sarcopenia after 40;** won't "bulk by accident" without genetics + drugs.
